Game Overview

In Ratomilton Imposter Us, the core idea is straightforward: join Ratomilton in a stealthy space adventure, where mischief meets mystery. Dance through chaos, eliminate AI crewmates, and sabotage systems undetected. Use vents for sneak attacks and blend into the space crew. Outsmart everyone and keep your tail wagging. Can you be the ultimate impostor on the spaceship?
